statement: theorem completed_square_quartic {K : Type} [CommRing K] (t B s alpha beta : K) : (t^2+B*t+s)^2+alpha*t+beta = t^4+2*B*t^3+(B^2+2*s)*t^2+(2*B*s+alpha)*t+s^2+beta

theorem quartic_to_weierstrass {K : Type} [CommRing K] (t y B s alpha beta x Y : K) (curve : y^2=(t^2+B*t+s)^2+alpha*t+beta) (abscissa : x=2*(y+t^2+B*t+s)) (ordinate : Y=2*x*t+B*x+alpha) : Y^2=x^3+(B^2-4*s)*x^2+(2*B*alpha-4*beta)*x+alpha^2
theorem inverse_finite_branch {K : Type} [CommRing K] (t B alpha x Y inverse : K) (ordinate : Y=2*x*t+B*x+alpha) (unit : inverse*(2*x)=1) : inverse*(Y-B*x-alpha)=t
theorem zero_abscissa_ordinate_factor {K : Type} [CommRing K] (Y alpha : K) (curve_at_zero : Y^2=alpha^2) : (Y-alpha)*(Y+alpha)=0

theorem actual_finite_zero_branch {K : Type} [CommRing K] (t B s alpha beta y x Y : K) (finite_root : alpha*t+beta=0) (ordinate_y : y= -(t^2+B*t+s)) (abscissa : x=2*(y+t^2+B*t+s)) (ordinate_Y : Y=2*x*t+B*x+alpha) : y^2=(t^2+B*t+s)^2+alpha*t+beta ∧ x=0 ∧ Y=alpha
theorem unique_finite_zero_parameter {K : Type} [CommRing K] (t alpha beta inverse : K) (unit : inverse*alpha=1) (finite_root : alpha*t+beta=0) : t= -inverse*beta

theorem conditional_trace_pullback_composition {E0 E1 E2 J : Type} [IntModule E0] [IntModule E1] [IntModule E2] [IntModule J] (p0 : E0 → J) (p1 : E1 → J) (p2 : E2 → J) (norm : J → E0) (norm_add : ∀ a b, norm (a+b)=norm a+norm b) (diagonal : ∀ x, norm (p0 x)=(2 : Int) • x) (cross1 : ∀ x, norm (p1 x)=0) (cross2 : ∀ x, norm (p2 x)=0) (x0 : E0) (x1 : E1) (x2 : E2) : norm (p0 x0+p1 x1+p2 x2)=(2 : Int) • x0

theorem conditional_odd_subgroup_injectivity {E J : Type} [IntModule E] (phi : E → J) (norm : J → E) (composite : ∀ x, norm (phi x)=(2 : Int) • x) (ell u v : Int) (bezout : 2*u+ell*v=1) (x y : E) (order_x : ell • x=0) (order_y : ell • y=0) (images_equal : phi x=phi y) : x=y

theorem conditional_dlp_scalar_transfer {E J : Type} [IntModule E] [IntModule J] (phi : E → J) (zero : phi 0=0) (addition : ∀ x y, phi (x+y)=phi x+phi y) (x : E) (k : Nat) : phi (repeatAdd x k)=repeatAdd (phi x) k
theorem primitive_shift_square {K : Type} [CommRing K] (g s : K) : (g+s)^2=g^2+2*s*g+s^2

theorem triangular_moore_transport_inverse {K : Type} [CommRing K] (s w0 w1 w2 v0 v1 v2 : K) (first : v0=w0) (second : v1=w1+s*w0) (third : v2=w2+2*s*w1+s^2*w0) : v0=w0 ∧ v1-s*v0=w1 ∧ v2-2*s*v1+s^2*v0=w2
